what_happened: The task amendment assumed the positive direction (prior findings reaching a later task) would need a new artifact-walker shared with the negative-direction sweep. Research found scripts/memory-harvest.sh already implements the needed mechanism (reads memory_candidates from state.json, confidence-gates, writes to the vault memory-retrieve.sh already injects at every dispatch preflight) but is 'presently uncalled' per its own header -- skill-todo's Stage 7 duplicates the logic inline instead of calling it, scoped only to /todo's completed-task archival batch. Ruled: wire memory-harvest.sh as an immediate per-dispatch call instead of building new ledger/matcher infra, avoiding the escape-hatch spawn entirely.

Research report Recommendation 1 asserts the agent-contract update should mirror 'how proposed_file_scope is already referenced from general-research-agent.md's own Stage 5/6/7 instructions'. Verified false at plan-authoring time: grep -rln proposed_file_scope over agents/ and skills/ in every extension returns zero hits -- proposed_file_scope is documented only in context/formats/return-metadata-file.md and consumed only by update-task-status.sh. The plan therefore treats the producer instruction as a genuinely new agent-contract addition (its own phase) rather than a mirror of an existing one.

Verified the plan's load-bearing jq mechanics directly at authoring time instead of asserting them: jq 1.8.2 supports Oniguruma lookbehind/lookahead (word-boundary matching without \\b's non-word-char pitfalls) and named-capture gsub regex escaping, both confirmed with one-line probes. This removed the main implementation-time unknown from the matcher phase before it was written.

Phase 1's return-metadata-file.md edit (835->869 lines) makes check-extension-docs.sh Rule R (stale index-entries.json line_count) red, as the plan's own Correction 3 and Risk table anticipated; Phase 5 re-derives it via generate-context-line-counts.sh --write per the plan's explicit staging. Also observed one pre-existing, unrelated gate-3 FAIL (scripts/tests/test-lint-agent-contracts-handoff-section.sh missing from provides.scripts, committed under a different task, outside this task's file_scope) -- not caused by this dispatch.

Phase 5's sync-manifest-scripts.sh --check found THREE missing provides.scripts entries, not the two the plan's Scope Hypothesis predicted: the two this task adds (sweep-invalidated-claims.sh, tests/test-sweep-invalidated-claims.sh) plus one pre-existing gap (tests/test-lint-agent-contracts-handoff-section.sh, committed under an unrelated already-landed task). --write is mechanical and derive-from-disk only (additive, never removes a declared-but-absent entry), so all three were written in one pass; the pre-existing gap's inclusion is incidental housekeeping, not scope creep into that other task's logic.
